newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Matahari active on 1997 net forecast.
newsitem.headline: Matahari active on 1997 net forecast.

text.p: Indonesian retailer PT Matahari Putra Prima shares rose on active trading on Thursday after it revised up its 1997 net profit target, brokers and analysts said.
In late morning session, Matahari was up 175 rupiah to 3,775 rupiah on a volume of 2.6 million shares after touching a high of 3,850 rupiah.

"Many overseas buyers are targeting Matahari shares after the company revised up its target to 91 billion rupiah from the previous 83 billion rupiah last week," an analyst with a Japanese brokerage firm said.

In a statement by Matahari to securities houses, which an analyst faxed to Reuters on Thursday, the firm set a net profit target of 91 billion rupiah for 1997, 121 billion rupiah for 1998 and 166 billion rupiah for 1999.
It also said the earnings per shares target for 1997 was 201 rupiah, 268 rupiah for 1998 and 368 rupiah for 1999.
The company has set a sales target of 2.31 trillion rupiah for 1997, 2.94 trillion rupiah for 1998 and 3.69 trillion rupiah for 1999.
The statement did not mention the previous targets.
